request.source:
-- 在临时隐藏控件上复现文本绑定问题；不修改目标内存或断点，结束后销毁控件。
local form = createForm(false)
local completed, result = pcall(function()
    local memo = createMemo(form)
    local edit = createEdit(form)
    local initialTextType = type(memo.Text)
    memo.Text = 'return true'
    local afterUnsupported = memo.getCaption()
    memo.setCaption('return true\nreturn false')
    edit.setCaption('RCX == 1')
    return {initialTextType=initialTextType, unsupportedWriteActualText=afterUnsupported,
        memoCaption=memo.getCaption(), memoLines=memo.Lines.Text,
        editCaption=edit.getCaption(), editText=edit.Text}
end)
form.destroy()
assert(completed, tostring(result))
return result
